messages:
tyler: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2345 - touches auth creds & telemetry. Need sec eyes on secrets surface and on‑prem/VPC impact before I merge. target merge Wed 11:00 UTC.

maria: thanks — quick skim. What's the new env var surface? looks like REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY?

tyler: correct. It's used to toggle verbose auth telemetry in Dedicated/Private. defaults to off. PR includes docs + migration plan.

alex: tagging @eng-infra — if private deployment reads that var we might need to ensure it doesn't leak in logs; also check vpc peering config for onprem tenants.

infra-bot: FYI: integration tests queued for private deployment matrix (linux, centos). build #456 running.

sec-bot: opened ticket SEC-789 for formal review. summary: new telemetry flag + secret handling change.

jess: legal flagged the telemetry field for PII risk. Did you strip any user identifiers?

tyler: yes — we switched to hashed user IDs (sha256) and added opt-out. snippet:
```
user_id_hash = sha256(user_id + salt)
telemetry.enabled = os.getenv("REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY") == \"1\"
```

maria: please add the salt rotation note to docs. also need KMS usage details for onprem (customers may use their KMS/HSM).

tyler: added KMS integration section and example config for onprem + sample policies (see docs/telemetry-kms.md). Also called out that default logs redact the telemetry key.

alex: quick check — does this change service account scopes? PR diff shows new iam:logs.write and iam:kms.decrypt — that needs sec approval.

sec-bot: noted new IAM scopes in SEC-789.

maria: can you add a short migration playbook for operators? steps for rolling restart, config rollout, and rollback.

tyler: done in the PR description (Migration -> Rollout Plan). I'll run a canary in dedicated tomorrow.

jess: legal ok with the hashed id + opt-out. approve contingent on an audit entry showing no raw ids stored.

maria: +1 to jess. once audit log is added I'll approve.

alex: I'll run a quick e2e on the VPC/onprem matrix after the canary and stamp approval if green.

tyler: thanks — timeline: canary Tue 20:00 UTC, merge Wed 11:00 UTC if no blocking issues. Ping me here for any blocking concerns.

maria: noted. pinging @eng-sre to watch canary metrics.

eng-sre: will monitor latency / error rate and check for any secrets leakage in logs.

tyler: great, thanks everyone. I'll update SEC-789 with the audit artifact once it's available.

deploy-bot: build #456 passed. canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z.

tyler: merging blocked until audit artifact posted; keeping target merge time but will delay if needed.

maria: thanks — leaving final LGTM after audit.

sec-bot: SEC-789 status: pending-audit

tyler: closing loop here later today with artifact. appreciate the reviews :thumbsup:
